name: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Captioner
description: Qwen2.5-VL 7B fine-tuned for text-to-image prompt generation

prompts.detailed: Describe this image in detail for use as a text-to-image prompt. Focus on the subject, composition, lighting, colors, mood, style, and any notable elements that would be useful for recreating this image.
prompts.short: Describe this image briefly in one or two sentences.
prompts.tags: List descriptive tags for this image, separated by commas. Include subject, style, mood, colors, and composition.
prompts.analyze: Analyze this image's composition, lighting, color palette, and artistic style.
